features.name: offer_mode
features.title: Offer mode: per-stage question sets, gap probing and STAR drill
features.description: Load apply/<empresa>.md-derived question sets (apply/sets/<empresa>.json -> js/offer-sets.js bundle or user-loaded file) so the interviewer asks about the offer's gaps (Celery, Vue, system design, Django...), with a stage selector and a STAR drill mode where the agent plays a hiring manager demanding action-result-metric per story. Source of the idea: apply/back_market.md §7.
acceptance: An active offer set drives the questions: builtin serves the set's literal questions per stage; remote receives the offer brief + gaps + stage focus in the prompt.
STAR drill: interviewer persona is a hiring manager iterating the set's stories (situation -> action -> result/metric), offline builtin fallback included.
No offer active => behavior byte-identical to the current simulator (default bank, default prompts, 6-answer session).
All new copy is bilingual (i18n keys, es+en); no hardcoded strings; file:// still works with zero servers.
sets for the 5 active offers generated in ../../apply/sets/ and bundled to js/offer-sets.js by scripts/build-offer-sets.py; invalid sets are rejected visibly, never silently.
